Ofalths reproduce asexually. When they first hatch from their leathery eggs, larval ofalths resemble a tendril of flesh supported by spindly legs, but they soon cocoon themselves in trash, to serve as both armor and camouflage. **[Recall Knowledge - Aberration](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44)): DC 19 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14 [Larval Ofalth](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3116) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 249 **Perception** +9; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1) **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +13, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +9 **Str** +5 **Dex** +1 **Con** +3 **Int** -2 **Wis** +1 **Cha** -2 **Hide in Filth** A larval ofalth can hide in any pile of filth or trash that is its size or larger, allowing it to use [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) for initiative. If it rolls Stealth for initiative, on the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) to it. --- **AC** 20 (22 with trash shield raised) **Fort** +11 **Ref** +9 **Will** +9 **HP** 60 **Immunities** disease, poison **[Stench](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=76)** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664)) 30 feet, DC 19
**[Shield Block](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=75)** The larval ofalth's trash shield has a hardness of 5 and 20 Hit Points. --- **Speed** 25 feet **Melee** claw +13, **Damage** 2d8+5 slashing plus wretched weeps **Ranged** leachate +11 ([range 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8 acid plus wretched weeps **Wretched Weeps** ([Disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46)) **Saving Throw** DC 19 Fortitude; **Stage 1** carrier with no ill effect (1 day); **Stage 2** 2d4 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) every hour and [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) (1 day); **Stage 3** 2d6 persistent bleed every hour and enfeebled 2 (1 day)
name: Larval Ofalth
